title: Demon Lord 2099 Novels End With 6th Volume
content: Kadokawa 's Fantasia Bunko imprint announced on Tuesday that author Daigo Murasaki and illustrator Kureta 's Demon Lord 2099 ( Maou 2099 ) light novel series will end with its sixth volume. Murasaki and Kureta released the first novel volume under Kadokawa in January 2021, and the fifth volume in November 2025.
author: ANN

title: One Piece English Dub Kicks Off Elbaph Arc With New Crunchyroll Release
content: Fans of the One Piece English dub release are in luck as the Elbaph Arc has finally kicked off its run with Crunchyroll with the first of its new weekly releases. One Piece returned for the Elbaph Arc earlier this year as part of a whole new era for the long running anime franchise.
author: ComicBook

title: 35 Years Later, Surprise Simpsons Character Returns From a Banned Episode
content: The Simpsons has seen a surprising character making their return after 35 long years in the newest episode, and fans never expected to see this banned character ever again. The Simpsons Season 38 has really thrown fans for a loop with one surprise after another as not only did it premiere a second Treehouse of Horror…
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach Creator Says Goodbye to Yhwach With New Look Ahead of Anime Finale
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has finally put a decisive end to the anime’s final fight with the penultimate end of the series after 22 years , and the creator behind it all has shared a cool new look at Yhwach to help celebrate.
author: ComicBook

title: Compile Heart's Villion:Code Game Launches in West on January 26
content: The game will get a Digital Deluxe Edition that includes a digital art book and soundtrack. The PS5 version will have physical editions in North America and Europe, and the Switch and PS4 versions will get physical editions in North America.
author: ANN

title: South Park Surprises With the Perfect JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Shout Out – Watch
content: South Park is no stranger to fun anime shout outs and Easter Eggs, but the latest episode really went all out to show JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure some love with some very familiar poses. South Park Season 29 has made some big changes through its three episodes so far for the year.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Hypes Jump Festa Update With New Look at Culling Game Roster Ahead of Season 4
content: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 is currently in the works, but fans might get an update sooner than expected. Based on a Weekly Shonen Jump manga written and illustrated by Gege Akutami, the anime adaptation by MAPPA is one of the most successful shows of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: Pandora Hearts Manga Gets 3rd Stage Musical
content: Jun Mochizuki 's Pandora Hearts manga is inspiring a third stage musical adaptation titled PandoraHearts Retrace III -Reverse corte- that will run at Theater H in Tokyo on September 17-26, 2027 and at Sankei Hall Breeze in Osaka on October 2-3, 2027. The staff streamed a trailer, but it is not available in the U.S.
author: ANN

title: Major Netflix Anime Teases Surprise Finale With New Trailer for October 2026 Return – Watch
content: A major anime series is coming back to Netflix for special new episodes later this month, and it turns out to be teasing a surprise finale with a new trailer and poster hyping up its debut.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Shingeki no Kyojin' Voice Actor Hiroshi Tsuchida Dies at 54
content: Voice actor Hiroshi Tsuchida , best known for Grisha Yeager in Shingeki no Kyojin ( Attack on Titan ) and Daikichi Kawachi in Usagi Drop ( Bunny Drop ), died on October 11 of heart failure. He was 54.
author: MyAnimeList
